newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank repo average rate falls to 15.55 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank repo average rate falls to 15.55 pct.

text.p: The average rate at a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Wednesday fell to 15.55 percent from 16.30 percent in a similar repo on Tuesday, the NBS said in a statement.
The NBS offered 1.5 billion crowns and bids totalled 2.955 billion crowns. The minimum accepted rate was 14.00 percent, while the maximum rate was 18.00 percent.
The NBS added 2.0 billion crowns to the interbank market through a one-week repo tender on Tuesday, with the average rate easing to 16.30 percent from 17.43 percent in a similar repo on Monday.
The central bank monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.

According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 29 lacked 0.64 percent of funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements. The daily volume of minimum reserves for commercial banks total 36.583 billion crowns in the current reserves period ending July 31.
